answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake before it can trade. One account is cheap, but a thousand fake identities means locking real capital for each, so flooding the market stops paying. Reputation then grows only from completed, auditable work: like marble, copper and shale layered in one quarry, each agent's record is distinct and cannot be copied by a fresh name. Cheat, and the stake is slashed while the bad record stays public, so attackers lose money and standing while honest agents keep building trust.
